note: Both sets share the same core errors: chord at the root is read as 100 m (the chord axis only goes to 6 m, so this is a misread of another panel's tick), prebend at the tip is given as +4 m when the curve goes to about -4 m, and the tip twist/pitch-axis values are approximate at best. The decisive difference is the relative-thickness claim: the curve is 100% at r/R=0 and about 20% at r/R=1, so A's '20% at r/R=1.0' is correct while B's '20% at r/R=0.0' is misbound. A does carry a self-contradiction (10% and 20% both at r/R=1.0), but it still contains one more faithful claim than B. Both also leave the true root chord (~5 m) unstated.
remarks: Values are read off plotted curves, so endpoint readings carry some uncertainty, but the sign of prebend (axis runs 0 to -4 m) and the chord axis range (0-6 m) make the 'chord 100 m' and 'prebend 4 m' claims clearly wrong in both sets. The text layer drops minus signs on the twist and prebend axes, which likely caused the sign errors. Both sets also miss the root chord length (~5.2 m) and the true root relative thickness (100%).
